name: vulnerabilities_and_secrets
description: Rules for detecting hardcoded secrets, wildcard postMessage, and insecure HTML inclusions

rules.name: hardcoded_aws_key
rules.description: Hardcoded AWS Access Key ID detected in client extension source code.

rules.name: hardcoded_api_token
rules.description: Hardcoded secret API token or credential detected in source code.

rules.name: wildcard_post_message
rules.description: window.postMessage using wildcard '*' target origin allows any untrusted frame to intercept sensitive messages.

rules.name: document_write_sink
rules.description: Usage of document.write() introduces severe DOM XSS risks and violates modern CSP standards.

rules.name: remote_html_script
rules.description: Remote script tag in HTML page violates Manifest V3 Content Security Policy requirements.

rules.name: outdated_jquery_library
rules.description: Referenced or bundled obsolete jQuery version containing known security vulnerabilities (CVE-2015-9251, CVE-2020-11022).
